## 3. Component README Summaries

### `imu9dof/README.md` (V1.0)
- **Hardware**: HT32F67595, board **HT32F67595-LGA28** with LSM6DSOW on SPI0, IST8310 magnetometer on LSM6 **Sensor Hub** (MCU doesn't directly drive mag I2C)
- **Pin map**: SCLK=P42, MOSI=P43, MISO=P44, CS=P00, DRDY(INT1)=P27
- **Capabilities**: WHO_AM_I, soft-reset, accel/gyro/temp, BDU, FIFO continuous, INT1 DRDY, wakeup/free-fall/6D config, Sensor-Hub read/write; IST8310 WIA, soft-reset, PDCNTL, averaging, single-shot, μT conversion, self-test (CAD0/CAD1 floating → I2C `0x0E`)
- **API**: `imu9dof_init()` / `imu9dof_read(&s)` returns all 9 axes + temp
- **Calls**: `ahrs_init/update/get_quat/get_euler` on top

### `ahrs/README.md` (V1.1)
- **Algorithms**: Madgwick (default for wearables, gradient descent 6/9-axis) + simplified EKF (7-state with gyro bias, +accel/mag correction). Auto-degrades to 6-axis when `bMagValid==false`.
- **V1.1 features**:
  - **Motion gating** `bMotionGateEn`: when `|||a||−1g| > fAccNormTol_g` (default 0.15g), skip accel correction this tick
  - **Rest bias** `bRestBiasEn` (Madgwick only): EMA gyro bias when stationary
  - **Queries**: `ahrs_is_motion()`, `ahrs_get_acc_norm_g()`
- **Tuning knobs**: `fMadgwickBeta` (0.05–0.2), `fAccNormTol_g` (0.15–0.3), `fRestBiasAlpha` (0.005–0.02), `fEkfR_acc`/`fEkfR_mag`
- **Files**: `ahrs.c` (top-level + gating), `ahrs_madgwick.c`, `ahrs_ekf.c`, `ahrs_internal.h`

### `ble_sensor/README.md`
- **Architecture**: MP samples sensor, pushes via IPC to CP which runs a **private GATT service** to phone
- **UUIDs**:
  - Service `0xFEA0`
  - Stream (Notify) `0xFEA1`
  - CMD (Write W/O Rsp) `0xFEA2`
- **Packet format (≤20B, default ATT MTU)**:
  - `0x01` IMU: seq, flags, acc_mg[3], gyr_0.1dps[3]
  - `0x02` ENV: seq, flags, IR_0.1C, IMU_temp_0.1C, BAT_mV, NTC_mV
  - `0x03` AHRS: seq, flags, roll/pitch/yaw 0.01°
  - `0x04` MAG: seq, flags, mag_0.1uT[3]
- **MP API**: `ble_sensor_sdk_init_mp(NULL)` then `ble_sensor_ipc_send_sample(&s)`
- **CP API**: `ble_sensor_sdk_init_cp(NULL, true)` + `ble_sensor_service_set_conn_handle(conn)` on connect/disconnect; depends on `ipc_general_queue.c`, `msg_queue.c`

### `gd60932/README.md`
- **Sensor**: GooDeTek **GD60932U** IR temperature (UART interface)
- **Pins**: TX_LOG=P41 (UART1 TX) → sensor RX (pin5), RX_LOG=P39 (UART1 RX) ← sensor TX (pin8). Cross-connected.
- **Shared UART1**: with `app_debug`. Disable logging during continuous measurement or don't printf concurrently.
- **Protocol**: 8N1, two speeds:
  - **MS** (~300 ms): 9600 bps
  - **FS** (~20 ms): 115200 bps
- **Commands** (HEX, configurable): `0xAA` object temp, `0xAB` body, `0xAC` ambient
- **Response**: ASCII `+000242` → 24.2 °C (0.1 °C unit)
- **API**: `gd60932_init`, `gd60932_measure`, `gd60932_read_body_c`, `gd60932_set_mode`, `gd60932_set_speed`, `gd60932_set_custom_cmd`

## 5. Key Entry Points

### MP main (`sources/projects_source/ble_examples/ble_peripheral/ht32f675x5_r2/main/mp/main.c`) — V1.1, holtek-copyright, 555 lines
- Initializes PMU (DC-DC 1.2V, LDO ACT 1.2V, LDO DIG 1.1V, LDO RET 1.1V)
- Sets system clock from DCXO 16M (`EN_SYS_CLK_DCXO16M`) with EFUSE RC tuning
- Calls `peripheral_init()` → `app_debug_init()`, `err_debug_init()`
- `system_lpwr_init(LPWR_MODE_SLEEP)` — sets retention SRAM max and `lpwr_ctrl_init`
- `system_enable_cp()` — configures CP remap, releases CP reset, gates CP clock
- Three optional test loops:
  - `TFLM_HELLO_TEST_ENABLED` → `tflm_hello_selftest()` + `tflm_hello_infer(1.57f, &y)` (sine model, expects ~1.0)
  - `SENSOR_SDK_TEST_ENABLED` → `sensor_sdk_test_run()` (never returns) — polls IMU/AHRS/IR/NTC/BAT, sends to BLE sensor IPC
  - Default → idle with `lpwr_ctrl_goto_sleep()`

### CP main (`sources/projects_source/ble_examples/ble_peripheral/ht32f675x5_r2/main/cp/main.c`) — V1.0, holtek-copyright, 72 lines
- Pure CMSIS-RTOS2 RTX bootstrap: `osKernelInitialize()` → `osThreadNew(app_main, NULL, &attr)` with 128-stack `m_u64AppMainStack[128]` → `osKernelStart()` → for(;;)
- Real `app_main` lives in `ble_task/`

### Architecture: MP + CP (dual-core)
- **MP (Cortex-M0+)** — Application core, runs sensors, temp fusion, optional TFLM inference, low-power management
- **CP (Cortex-M0+)** — BLE controller core, runs BLE 5.1 stack + GATT services, forwards data to phone over BLE
- **IPC**: `ipc_general/` + `msg_queue/` + `ble_sensor_ipc` for MP↔CP

| `CMSIS/5.7.0/` | ARM CMSIS pack 5.7.0 — `DAP/` (CMSIS-DAP firmware), `Driver/` (CMSIS Driver wrappers), `DSP/` (CMSIS-DSP libs incl. `lib/ARM/`), `Include/`, `RTOS2/RTX/` (CMSIS-RTOS2 RTX kernel source + library + template) |
| `tflm-tree/` | TensorFlow Lite Micro sources (pruned) — `tensorflow/lite/{micro,experimental/microfrontend,kernels/internal,schema,types,c}`, `signal/{micro/kernels,src,testdata,tensorflow_core}`, plus third-party `flatbuffers/`, `gemmlowp/`, `kissfft/`, `ruy/` matrix-multiplication library. Vendor pruning trees for arc/ceva/chre/cortex_m/hexagon/xtensa/riscv32 all present but only `cortex_m_generic` + `cmsis_nn` kernels are buildable on HT32. Targets listed: `cortex_m_corstone_300`, `cortex_m_generic`, `xtensa`, `hexagon`, `arc_custom`, `arc_emsdp`, `bluepill`, `ceva`, `chre`, `riscv32_generic`, `ethos_u`, `cmsis_nn` |

## 9. Hardware / Architecture Summary

### Target SoC
- **Holtek HT32F67595** — dual-core Cortex-M0+ (MP + CP), BLE 5.1, LGA28 package
- Custom board (`HT32F67595_USER` define, `ht32f67595_user.h`)

### Sensors on this board
| Signal | Function | Component |
|---|---|---|
| LSM6DSOW (SPI0) | 6-axis accel+gyro, sensor-hub master | `lsm6dsow/` |
| IST8310 (via LSM6 hub) | 3-axis magnetometer | `ist8310/` |
| GD60932U (UART1) | IR temperature (object/body/ambient) | `gd60932/` |
| NTC thermistor (ADC, P21) | Skin/board ambient | `ntc/` |
| Battery (ADC, P09) | Battery voltage | `ntc::ntc_read_bat_mv` |
| MCU die temp | Junction temp | `ntc::ntc_read_mcu_c` |
| IMU die temp | LSM6DSOW internal | `lsm6dsow` |

### BLE Profiles Available (8 standard GATT + 1 private)
- Standard: BAS/BLS/CGMS/CTS/DIS/GAP/GATT/GLS/HRD/HTS/MUS/OTA/PLXS/WSS (stock library) + custom app profiles: BLS, CGM, CGM-LP, GLS, HRS, HTS, PLXS, WSS
- Private: `ble_sensor` `0xFEA0` (IMU/ENV/AHRS/MAG stream)

### AI / ML Components
- **TensorFlow Lite Micro** (`tflm-tree/`) — built into CP/MP for on-device inference
- Verified working via `tflm_app/tflm_hello_*` — INT8 sine model with `MicroMutableOpResolver<1>` (FullyConnected), `kArenaSize=4096`, `alignas(16)`
- `tools/build_tflm_tree.py`, `tools/add_tflm_sources_to_keil.py`, `tools/gen_hello_model_array.py` — build / integrate scripts
- Models: only `hello_world_int8_model_data` (sin curve) currently checked in

### Algorithm Stack
- AHRS: Madgwick (default) + simplified EKF with motion-gating + rest-bias correction
- Sensor fusion: `imu9dof` (9-axis) + `temp_fusion` (4-source temperature: GD-IR obj + NTC + MCU + IMU)
- TFLM: validated INT8 inference path

### Power
- `lpwr_ctrl` framework, DCXO16M → PLL64M sleep/wake hand-shake via shared `SYS_CTRL_COM_REG_CP_WFI_FLAG`
- `LPWR_MODE_SLEEP` with `RAM_APP_SIZE_KBYTE_MAX` retention
- `Lowpower_evaluation/ble_low_power` reference project

### OS
- **CMSIS-RTOS2 RTX** (ARM, in `third_party/CMSIS/5.7.0/CMSIS/RTOS2/RTX/`)

- Last commit: `v1.02` (before current WIP diff)

# Final Comprehensive Report

The Prj1V0 codebase is a **Holtek HT32F67595 dual-core BLE 5.1 firmware project** (sensors + private GATT streaming + on-device TFLM inference). It targets a custom LGA28 board carrying **LSM6DSOW + IST8310 IMU (SPI + sensor-hub), GD60932U IR temperature (UART1), NTC thermistor, and battery monitoring (ADC)**. The application is built around the **MP+CP pattern**: MP does sensor sampling, AHRS (Madgwick or EKF), temperature fusion, and optional TFLM inference; CP runs the BLE 5.1 stack and 8 standard GATT profiles (BLS/CGM/GLS/HRS/HTS/PLXS/WSS/CGM-LP) plus a private `0xFEA0` streaming service. The `third_party/` folder holds CMSIS 5.7.0 (with CMSIS-RTOS2 RTX) and a pruned TensorFlow Lite Micro tree. **No SSD2386 references exist anywhere in the tree** — the only processor is HT32F67595. All four component READMEs (imu9dof, ahrs, ble_sensor, gd60932) are present and provide integration instructions, pin maps, packet formats, and tuning guidance. The most recently modified files (per git status) are the AHRS module adding motion-gating + rest-bias features (V1.1) and a small tweak to the peripheral mp `main.c`. The currently-active MP entry point is `sources/projects_source/ble_examples/ble_peripheral/ht32f675x5_r2/main/mp/main.c` (V1.1, 555 lines); the CP entry is `…/main/cp/main.c` (V1.0, 72 lines of pure RTX bootstrap).
